N01_witness.divergence_formula: Delta(d) = mean_rho ||Phi_fwd^d(rho) - Phi_rev^d(rho)||_1 vs depth d, per GKSL strength

carrier: density operators rho in D(C^2); genuine layer channels Ti/Te/Fi/Fe (strength-independent) + Weyl-L/R GKSL (strength = (T,steps)); HS norm, trace norm. NO CTMRG, NO PEPS, NO optimization.
claim_ceiling: MEASURES the forward-vs-reversed divergence-vs-depth curve, its saturation (lock-in) depth, and order-dependent survivor persistence on the genuine channel set across four GKSL relaxation strengths, vs an explicit noise floor and a commuting control. Does NOT assert layer-completion / manifold admission / coupling / bridge / flux / FEP / physics. A saturation-depth-vs-strength scaling here is a CANDIDATE order-memory lock-in diagnostic, not a proven ratchet edge.

commuting_control.note: z-pinches in one basis: commute and carry no GKSL leg, so identical across all GKSL strengths by construction. MUST stay at the floor (flat curve) and pick the SAME survivor at every strength.

noise_floor.definition: eps(Float64) * max PTM HS scale (=2.0) * deepest het word length (384) * 8 safety

open_falsifier_resolved: Is the depth~6 divergence saturation seen in ratchet_accumulation_killtest.jl the genuine ratchet REACHING its survivor (lock-in depth grows as GKSL weakens, survivor persists) or an ARTIFACT of strong GKSL relaxation (flat at all strengths / no survivor)?

reframe_lockin_depth_vs_strength.note: saturation_depth_series ordered strong->medium->weak->very_weak. GENUINE ratchet-to-survivor predicts this series is nondecreasing AND grows somewhere (gentler step => more depth to lock in). -1 entries mean no lock-in (plateau below floor) at that strength.

reused_from: ratchet_accumulation_killtest.jl (genuine channels, same as order_null_killtest.jl / L7/L10/L11 _bf layers). NO new channels invented; only the GKSL (T,steps) strength is swept.

tool_manifest.Z3: load_bearing: binds the genuine survivor spread at the weakest strength to the commuting law; verdict flips UNSAT->SAT on the commuting control.

verdict.interpretation: ratchet_reaches_survivor requires: every GKSL strength above floor and saturating, lock-in depth nondecreasing AND growing as strength weakens, the order-dependent survivor persisting at every strength, and the commuting control flat with the same survivor. saturation_was_artifact if weakening GKSL drives divergence below the floor or kills the survivor at any strength. mixed if signals partially hold. This settles whether the depth~6 saturation in ratchet_accumulation_killtest.jl is genuine survivor lock-in (ratchet drive-down) or an artifact of strong relaxation.
